attributes.readMe:
## Proposal

`title`, `narrative` (MarkdownField), `deal` (linksTo the realm's existing `Deal`). Kept deliberately separate from `Quote`: a Proposal sells the WHY, a Quote states the HOW MUCH. Conflating them forces every early-stage one-pager into a pricing document before the deal is even qualified for one.

### Non-goals
Does not carry pricing — that's `Quote`, which can optionally link back to the Proposal it formalizes. Does not track approval/e-signature (Could-Have, could reuse the realm's existing `ApprovalChainField`).

### Example
`linkedExamples` points at `Proposal/acme-enterprise-renewal-proposal`, linked to the real `Deal/acme-enterprise-renewal` instance already on this realm (a live, in-negotiation deal — not a fabricated one).
attributes.cardDescription: A narrative sales document (goals, scope, value proposition) sent before pricing is finalized, distinct from a Quote.
